<div class="card-body">
'''Our First Catch Of The Day''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">本日最初の獲物だ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：牽引ビームの運命数に2を加える。2：「最初の輸送艇が突破しました！」か「ハイパー・エスケープ」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Our-First-Catch-Of-The-Day-PSA-88099880.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「艦長、反乱軍の宇宙船が我々の警戒区域に接近しつつあります」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Our First Catch Of The Day.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Add 2 to a tractor beam destiny. Cancel The First Transport Is Away! or Hyper Escape.

'''Lore:'''
Captain, Rebel starships are approaching our alert sector.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text numbers two choices, says 牽引ビーム, and quotes Japanese titles for The First Transport Is Away! and Hyper Escape.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Our First Catch Of The Day]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
